figures.alt: Repeated manuscript fragments stop at a crimson audit plane and resolve into one canonical fragment below it.
The book journey moves from preventing a proposed duplicate, through routine live checks, to evidence-led cleanup and a lower repository ceiling.
An incoming repeated manuscript sheet is intercepted before a layered repository, while existing repeated sheets converge into one retained sheet.

figures.alt: DRY is a design principle about the authoritative representation of knowledge; Deslop is an evidence system that finds source already repeated and prompts an explicit response.
Three identical source slabs move through an evidence gate toward five legitimate outcomes: reuse, move ownership, delete, generate, or retain with a recorded reason.
